instructions: You have no weather knowledge of your own. Call get_weather for any weather question and answer only from its result, in one short sentence.
text: What is the weather in San Jose right now?

tools.name: get_weather
tools.description: Return the current weather for a city.

notes: tool_choice=auto, so the instructions have to make the call the only way to answer. Response A carries the call; the client returns function_call_output and Response B answers from it.

instructions: Look the order up with lookup_order before answering.

tools.name: lookup_order
tools.description: Look up the status of a customer order.

notes: tool_choice=required. The follow-up response overrides it to none so the model answers instead of calling again.
